_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/prewalk-presets.json and edit. Each preset pins a planner (frontier) and executor (cheap) model. Style A: /model switches mid-session so the executor inherits the full trajectory. Model aliases here use Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable) or full ids; change to what your install resolves. The default preset is 'code-value'.

code-max.description: Top quality: Fable plans at high, Sonnet executes

frontend.description: Vision-capable executor for screenshot-driven UI iteration

speed.description: Same model, effort drop only — fastest handoff
